# Inference

**Package** `telividb.inference.v1`

## Services

### `Inference`

Computes vectors, and deliberately does not write them.  Two writers to one store is how provenance diverges: this returns, and the points service stores. It is also the single compute boundary — ingest embedding, query encoding and every plugin's compute step arrive here, which is what makes a permission check before a model runs possible at all.

| Method | Request | Response | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GetModel` | `GetModelRequest` | `Model` | Retrieves a single model. |
| `ListModels` | `ListModelsRequest` | `ListModelsResponse` | Lists models known to the inference server. |
| `EmbedText` | `EmbedTextRequest` | `EmbedTextResponse` | Computes embeddings for a batch of text. Policy is evaluated before the model runs, not only before results return. That is stronger than checking at the query planner alone: it stops a caller producing a vector for data it was never granted, rather than hiding the output afterwards. |

## Messages

### `Vector`

A vector, carried as raw bytes rather than a repeated scalar.  Protobuf encodes a repeated scalar element by element, so a 768-dimension vector would cost 768 varint operations per message in each direction on the hot path. One length-delimited field costs one.

| Field | Type | # | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | `bytes` | 1 | `REQUIRED` | Raw little-endian IEEE-754 single-precision components. |
| `dimensions` | `int32` | 2 | `REQUIRED` | Number of components, so a reader can validate before casting. |

### `EmbedTextRequest`

Request message for computing embeddings.

| Field | Type | # | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `model` | `string` | 1 |  | Model to encode with. |
| `input` | `repeated string` | 2 | `REQUIRED` | Text to encode. One or many; the call is the same either way. |
| `task` | `Task` | 3 | `OPTIONAL` | Whether this is document-side or query-side encoding. Not cosmetic: the two use different prefixes, and for a jointly trained model a query routes to the other tower entirely. Encoding a query through the document tower returns plausible garbage rather than an error. |
| `truncate` | `bool` | 4 | `OPTIONAL` | Whether to truncate input longer than the model's context. Defaults to true. The alternative is failing a batch of ten thousand because one document was long. |

### `EmbedTextResponse`

Response message for computing embeddings.

| Field | Type | # | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `embeddings` | `repeated Vector` | 1 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | The vectors, in the order the inputs were given. |
| `model_digest` | `string` | 2 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Digest of the model that produced them — the identity, not the label. |
| `load_duration` | `google.protobuf.Duration` | 3 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Time spent loading the model. Near zero is the proof a model stayed resident rather than being reloaded, which is the difference between batching working and not. |
| `prompt_token_count` | `int32` | 4 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Tokens consumed across the batch. |

### `Model`

A GGUF model the inference server can hold resident.

| Field | Type | # | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | 1 | `IDENTIFIER` | Resource name of the model. |
| `digest` | `string` | 2 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Digest of the model file. The identity, not the label. A vector field binds to this rather than to a name, because two files called the same thing produce different vectors and mixing them into one index degrades recall with nothing reporting it. Computed from the bytes read, never trusted from metadata. |
| `architecture` | `string` | 3 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Architecture, read from the file rather than configured. |
| `dimensions` | `int32` | 4 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Components in the vectors this model produces. |
| `context_length` | `int32` | 5 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Maximum input length in tokens. |
| `quantization` | `string` | 6 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Quantization the file carries, such as `Q4_K_M`. |
| `resident` | `bool` | 7 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Whether the model is currently loaded on a device. Several models stay resident at once and nothing swaps per call: reloading between calls would defeat the batching that makes in-process inference worth having. |
| `resident_bytes` | `int64` | 8 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Device memory this model occupies while resident. |
| `create_time` | `google.protobuf.Timestamp` | 9 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | When the model was registered. |
| `etag` | `string` | 10 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Opaque value for optimistic concurrency on update. |

## Enums

### `Task`

Whether text is being encoded as a document or as a query.

| Value | # | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `TASK_UNSPECIFIED` | 0 | Default value. Treated as a document. |
| `TASK_DOCUMENT` | 1 | Content being stored. |
| `TASK_QUERY` | 2 | A query being matched against stored content. |
